commitments.statement: This Compass bootstrap may modify only .project-compass/ and must preserve unrelated dirty work, ownership, and canonical project documents.
Intended, planned, implemented, and verified truth remain separate; weak or unexecuted evidence stays unknown or uncertain.

source.note: The previously proposed AIOS four-child/source-layer split was explicitly marked deprecated.

reconciliations.incoming: The previously proposed AIOS four-child/source-layer split is deprecated and must not be ratified as current intent.

project_evidence.note: The earlier boundary quiz had no answers and is now retained as abandoned history; a replacement reassessment is active.
AIOS root governance remains the observed source for hard stops and authority boundaries.

preserved: The AIOS root Compass and its global governance boundaries
The requirement that child Compasses must have independently meaningful purposes
The need for an intent-first reassessment before boundary ratification
changed: The previous four-child/source-layer proposal is no longer current intent
AIOS boundary selection is reopened through a replacement realignment quiz
contradicted: Any assumption that the earlier four-child split is approved or should be retained
deferred: AIOS ICM boundary-map catalog until the replacement quiz is answered
left_behind: The abandoned unanswered quiz as an active decision surface
unknown: Which AIOS boundaries, if any, should receive child Compasses after reassessment
reconciliations.question: Which AIOS capabilities should receive independently aligned Compasses, if any, after the deprecated split is reconsidered?
reconciliations.reason: The owner explicitly deprecated the prior boundary recommendation, so the system must not treat it as ratified intent.
reconciliations.user_decision: Deprecated the previously proposed AIOS four-child/source-layer split.
